description: How this connection pays, its credit balance in dollars, each tool's price, and a link where the person can add credit by card. Call it when the person asks what's left or how to pay, or to connect another device to the same balance. Free. It returns no plan data.

new_device_code.description: true = also make a one-time code (good for 15 minutes) that connects an app on another device to this same balance without paying again. Only when the person asks for it.
